# TemplatesOwl

> > TemplatesOwl provides downloadable, fillable PDF forms and templates for government, legal, financial, and administrative purposes across federal, state, and international jurisdictions.

Founded by Eleanor Wright, TemplatesOwl offers a comprehensive library of form templates including US military forms (AHRC 56 R), tax documents (IRS forms, India Income Tax Form 15G), state-specific legal forms (California, Texas, New York, Arizona), and specialized templates for financial services, credit reporting, insurance, and educational applications.

## Key Topics

- fillable PDF forms
- tax forms and declarations
- military forms (AHRC 56 R, USAR)
- state government forms (California, Texas, New York, Arizona)
- IRS tax documents
- India Income Tax (Form 15G, Section 197A)
- legal and court forms
- credit and financial forms
- insurance and beneficiary forms
- permit applications
- TDS exemption
- Fair Credit Reporting Act
- DMV and vehicle forms
- employer compliance forms
- educational fee waivers

## Tax and Financial Forms

- [Download 15G Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/fillable-15g-form): India Income Tax Form 15G for TDS exemption declaration
- [Download 3561 Bklt Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/form-3561-bklt): California tax installment agreement form for payment plans
- [Download Auto Credit Personal Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/auto-credit-personal-form): IRS Form 8910 for alternative motor vehicle tax credit
- [Download Adverse Action Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/adverse-action-form): Fair Credit Reporting Act adverse action notice form template

## Military and Government Forms

- [Download Ahrc 56 R Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/ahrc-56-r-form): US Army Reserve AHRC 56 R promotion statement form for officers
- [Download Ao 88B Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/ao-88b): Federal court AO 88B subpoena for civil action document production
- [Download Arizona New Hire Reporting Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/arizona-new-hire-reporting-form): Arizona employer new hire reporting compliance form

## State and Legal Forms

- [Download 612 Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/form-612): Texas Form 612 for foreign entity registration termination
- [Download Aa 33 New York Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/form-aa-33-new-york): NY DMV Traffic Violations Bureau appeal form AA-33
- [Download Ally Transfer Of Equity Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/ally-transfer-of-equity-form): Ally Financial vehicle ownership transfer and equity form

## Insurance and Beneficiary Forms

- [Download 0009001 Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/form-0009001): Life insurance beneficiary change form for Universal Guaranty policies
- [Download Authoization Direction Pay Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/authoization-direction-pay-form): Auto collision repair authorization and insurance payment direction form

## Permits and Applications

- [Download Alarm Permit Application Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/alarm-permit-application): Fort Worth alarm permit application for residential/commercial systems
- [Download Alarm System Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/alarm-system-form): Jackson, TN alarm system user permit registration form
- [Download Application Fee Waiver Form](https://templatesowl.com/printable-pdf-forms/application-fee-waiver): College application fee waiver for ACT/SAT and FRPL students
